name: Ainge

attributes.attribute: turned logs into living trees to guard them
owned a cauldron whose water ebbed like the tide

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ainge was an Irish goddess and a daughter of the Dagda. She used magic to guard the logs she was gathering against theft, turning them into living trees. She owned a tub, or cauldron, in which the water would ebb and flow as though it were the tide.
objective: Record Ainge, the daughter of the Dagda with the tide-cauldron.
key_results: Show her tree magic and her ebb-and-flow cauldron.
